records.text: Ana Kasparian's great-grandmother survived a death march during the Armenian genocide, while her great-grandfather was killed.
records.speaker: Ana Kasparian

appearances.snippet: Armenians became, you know, they fled. Many went to Syria. They were forced to do a death march as my great-grandmother was, and she survived it, but my great-grandfather didn't. This is on my dad's side.

verification.notes: This is private family history about unnamed ancestors. The general Armenian genocide death marches are documented, but no accessible family or archival record verifies the claimed identities and outcomes.
